get.summary: List the caller's own API keys.
get.description: Requires an operator (session or API key). Metadata only, never the secret.

post.summary: Create a new API key for the calling operator.

201.description: API key created; token shown once

delete.summary: Delete one of the caller's own API keys.
delete.description:
Requires an operator (session or API key). Another operator's key answers 404, not
revealing it exists.

404.description: Not found or not owned by caller

post.summary: Check what the filter engine would decide for a domain, without querying DNS.
post.description:
Requires an operator (session or API key). Evaluates the live engine and answers
`{"action": "blocked", "rule": ..., "list": ...}` or `{"action": "allowed", "rule": ...}`
(`rule` omitted when no allow rule matched).

get.description:
Unauthenticated, so monitoring and setup can call it before any operator exists.
Reports whether initial setup is still pending.
Requires an operator (session or API key). Includes built-in and user-added lists.

post.summary: Add a new filter list by URL.

400.description: Missing name, or a URL noadd cannot fetch

put.summary: Update a filter list's enabled state, name, and/or URL.
put.description:
Requires an operator (session or API key). `enabled` applies on its own; name and URL
only when both are given. Triggers an async filter-engine rebuild.

delete.description: Requires an operator (session or API key). Triggers an async filter-engine rebuild.

get.summary: List recent DNS query logs, most recent first.
get.description: Supports pagination and filters; returns `logs` plus the `total` matching the filters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of log entries to return (default 100).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of entries to skip from the most recent, for pagination (default 0).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against the queried domain.

parameters.name: blocked
parameters.description: Filter by outcome: `true` returns only blocked queries, `false` only allowed.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Restrict to queries served through a specific `DoH` URL token.

200.description: Matching query logs and total count

delete.description: Permanently clears the entire query-log history.

get.description: Requires an operator (session or API key). Returned in the syntax they were added in.

post.description:
Requires an operator (session or API key). A new rule returns 201 with its id; an
existing one is a no-op 200 with `id: 0`; unparseable text is a 400. Triggers an async
filter-engine rebuild.

delete.description: Requires an operator (session or API key). Triggers an async filter-engine rebuild.

get.summary: Get the server's bound addresses and TLS status.
get.description: Requires an operator (session or API key).
Requires an operator (session or API key). Only known setting keys are returned.

put.summary: Update one or more runtime settings.
put.description:
Requires an operator (session or API key). Only keys in the body change; everything is
validated before anything is written, so a bad value rejects the whole request.
Upstream, strategy, DNSSEC and block-mode changes apply without a restart.

get.summary: Get aggregate query statistics for today, the last 7 days, and the last 30 days.
get.description:
Requires an operator (session or API key). Totals, block ratio, cache hit rate and
average response time per window, plus the last minute's query rate.

url.description: URL the list's contents are fetched from.

id.description: Id of the newly created filter list.

rule.description:
Rule text in hosts-file or Adblock-style syntax, e.g.
`ads.example.com` or `@@allow.example.com`.

id.description: Id of the created rule, or `0` if it already existed.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) the key was created.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) after which the key stops working, if any.

last_used_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) the key was last used to authenticate, if ever.

name.description: Human-readable label given at creation time.

prefix.description:
Short, non-secret prefix used to identify the key; the full secret
is never returned again after creation.

expires_at.description:
Optional Unix timestamp (seconds) after which the key stops working.
Omit or `null` for a key that never expires.

name.description: Human-readable label for the key (1-64 characters), e.g. `"ci"`.

id.description: Id of the newly created key.

name.description: The label given at creation time.

prefix.description: Short, non-secret prefix used to identify the key afterwards.

token.description: Full secret — shown only in this create response, never again.

rule.description: Rule text in hosts-file or Adblock-style syntax.

domain.description: Domain to evaluate, e.g. `"ads.example.com"`; a trailing dot is stripped.

FilterListResponse.description:
A filter list, plus what removing it would cost. `FilterListRow`'s fields are spelled out
rather than flattened so the `OpenAPI` document shows one flat object.

enabled.description: Whether the list's rules are currently applied by the filter engine.

last_updated.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) the list was last downloaded, or `0` if never.

rule_count.description: Number of rules parsed out of the list's content on last download.

unique_rules.description:
Rules no other loaded list provides: what removing this list would unblock. `null`
when it contributes no rules (disabled, empty, or failed to download).

url.description: Source URL the list's contents are fetched from.

needs_setup.description:
True when no operator exists yet and `POST /api/auth/setup` must be called first.
Always false under forward auth, where the first proxied request provisions one.

status.description: Always `"ok"` while the process is up and serving requests.

dns_addr.description: Address the plain-DNS listener is bound to, e.g. `0.0.0.0:53`.

http_addr.description: Address the admin/DoH HTTP(S) listener is bound to.

tls_enabled.description: Whether the HTTP listener is serving TLS (ACME or user-provided certs).

Summary.description:
`Default` is all zeroes: what the dashboard renders when the read fails,
and what an appliance that has answered nothing reports anyway.

avg_response_ms_30d.description: Average response time in milliseconds over the trailing 30 days.

avg_response_ms_7d.description: Average response time in milliseconds over the trailing 7 days.

avg_response_ms_today.description: Average response time in milliseconds over the trailing 24 hours.

block_ratio_30d.description: `blocked_30d / total_30d`, or `0` if there were no queries in the window.

block_ratio_7d.description: `blocked_7d / total_7d`, or `0` if there were no queries in the window.

block_ratio_today.description: `blocked_today / total_today`, or `0` if there were no queries in the window.

blocked_30d.description: Queries blocked in the trailing 30 days.

blocked_7d.description: Queries blocked in the trailing 7 days.

blocked_today.description: Queries blocked by the filter engine in the trailing 24 hours.

cache_hit_rate_30d.description: Fraction of allowed queries in the trailing 30 days answered from cache.

cache_hit_rate_7d.description: Fraction of allowed queries in the trailing 7 days answered from cache.

cache_hit_rate_today.description: Fraction of allowed queries in the trailing 24 hours answered from cache.

queries_1m.description: Queries handled in the last 60 seconds (a rough current-rate indicator).

total_30d.description: Total queries handled in the trailing 30 days.

total_7d.description: Total queries handled in the trailing 7 days.

total_today.description: Total queries handled in the trailing 24 hours.

enabled.description: If present, enables or disables the list.

name.description: New display name; only applied if `url` is also present.

url.description: New source URL; only applied if `name` is also present.
